## Highlights

- **BLE LE 1M PHY from scratch**: GFSK modulator (BT 0.5, h 0.5), channel selection, FM discriminator with
  integrate-and-dump, sync-word correlation, CFO correction, Gardner timing recovery, de-whitening, CRC-24 and
  advertising-PDU parsing. Decodes meshfind tag adverts built by the meshfind reference code.
- **LoRa CSS PHY from scratch**: SF7-SF12 at any bandwidth, preamble/sync-word detection, integer and fractional
  CFO and STO estimation, Gray mapping, diagonal interleaving, Hamming FEC (CR 4/5-4/8), whitening, header,
  CRC-16 and low-data-rate optimisation; time on air matches the Semtech formula sample for sample.
- **Monte Carlo against theory**: BLE BER within about 1 dB of the non-coherent BFSK curve at BER 1e-3;
  LoRa uncoded SER on top of the non-coherent orthogonal-FSK integral for all six spreading factors
  (all simulated, see the README).
- **SDR I/O**: cs8/cs16/cf32, SigMF, HackRF (`hackrf_transfer`) and PlutoSDR (pyadi-iio) sources, a ring buffer
  and a streaming receiver behind `sdrmesh rx ble --source hackrf|pluto|file|stdin`.
- **meshfind over LoRa**: a router-to-router frame format carrying two 120-byte meshfind report frames per
  LoRa packet, tested end to end (relay seals, LoRa PHY carries, owner decrypts).

## Downloads

- `sdrmesh-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl`, `sdrmesh-0.1.0.tar.gz`: the Python package (`pip install <wheel>`;
  add `meshfind @ git+https://github.com/coopersimpson101-debug/meshfind` for tag decoding).
- `sdrmesh-demo-captures.tar.gz`: **synthetic** captures generated by this release in CI: a SigMF recording of
  12 meshfind adverts on BLE channel 37 at 4 MS/s (Eb/N0 18 dB), the same without noise as `cs8` for
  `hackrf_transfer -t`, and a LoRa SF9/125 kHz frame (`cf32`, 4x oversampled).
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: checksums of the files above.

## Not yet verified

- No over-the-air reception or transmission has been done: the HackRF and PlutoSDR paths are implemented
  and unit-tested without hardware only.
- BLE: tested only on signals from its own modulator (no openly licensed reference IQ capture was found).
- LoRa: validated only against its own modulator and the published gr-lora_sdr whitening table; not yet
  checked against an SX127x/SX126x radio or gr-lora_sdr captures.
- Real-time throughput on a live 4 MS/s stream has not been measured with hardware.
